_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil with no breaker: F&G in Hope band, 30d momentum ~50, funding neutral — base rate favors HOLD until a named breaker prints.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicit HOLD/Hope; narrative silent on forward phase and only describes rising greed
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays range-bound with 30d momentum near 50 and funding near zero while F&G holds roughly 60-75
next_move.invalidated_if: 30d momentum breaks above 65 with funding lifting (toward Optimism) or F&G drops through 55 with a volatility spike (toward Disbelief)
